Hasanoud Mukhallat Al Hind – ₹3,999: Most premium option; traditional Indian/oud profile and concentrated oil format. Good if you want something distinctive.

Parag White Oudh – ₹2,499: Cleaner, softer oud direction; better suited to everyday wear than heavier traditional attars.

Ajmal Royal Gift Pack – ₹1,999: Four different non-alcoholic attars, with Ajmal reporting 8–12+ hours on skin. Good if you want variety rather than one signature scent. 
in.ajmal.com
